policy: Every interval is half-open [start, end). A screen calibration and its candidates share one interval; selection, gate, confirmation, high-fidelity, and self-skew intervals are disjoint.
rules_epoch: Blocks below the v23 marker were measured under the PRE-2026-08-16 rules (scripted oracle on, no repetition, no reuse, no finisher). They are spent AND their numbers are not comparable to anything measured after that date. Do not reuse them for a v23-era candidate: a fresh block is cheap, a confounded gate is not.

blocks.name: v23_checkpoint_screen
blocks.note: The screen runs its own incumbent self-calibration on this same interval, so no pre-measurement is needed here.

blocks.name: v23_binding_gate
blocks.note: gate.book_leg_offsets(960) allocates vs_v22=960, vs_ramp=1060, vs_v22_confirm=1080. V22 self-calibration measured under the new rules at 960 and 1080.

blocks.name: v23_replicate_screen
blocks.note: For a seed replicate, so a lucky first arm cannot be confirmed on its own block.
